recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: july fog sitting low over san francisco before the sun breaks through
cheap car screens swallowing every knob and dial
a thousand-word contest hunting for stories that fit in a breath
electric interceptor drone carving air at four hundred thirty-four miles per hour
stutter-house pulses looping through a quiet coding week
summer overcast keeping the bay cool at fourteen degrees

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Tap stutter beats on a foggy skyline as house pulses sync to Fred-again-style drops — miss a beat and the whole loop glitches.
composer-2.5-fast.touch_control: tap on beat markers as they stutter across lanes
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: nail one clean sixteen-beat loop before the drop lands
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: BPM climbs, stutter gaps shrink, off-beat taps add visual noise
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: neon wireframe buildings dissolving into gray summer mist

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Flick an electric interceptor drone through a car infotainment UI where every menu tile is an obstacle — speed readout climbs toward a world record.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.touch_control: flick to launch, hold to boost through tight gaps
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: beat your personal mph high score in under sixty seconds
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: touchscreen panels spawn faster, tilt sensitivity increases, speed cap approaches 434
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: harsh LCD blue glow on cheap matte plastic bezels

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Drag scrambled word tiles into a single vivid micro-story — exactly sixty words, no more — before the blinking cursor runs out of patience.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.touch_control: drag tiles into sentence slots left to right
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: complete one tight paragraph that actually reads like a story
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: timer shrinks, decoy words multiply, grammar traps appear mid-sentence
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: cream paper cutout typescript with red proof marks

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Draw a single continuous path through drifting dream-pop mist, collecting chord fragments while Enya-like currents try to erase your trail.
gemini-3.1-pro.touch_control: drag to sketch a path, release to let it echo and resonate
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: string three harmonies together in one unbroken gesture
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: fog thickens, paths fade faster, wind pushes petals into your route
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: watercolor summer gray-gold with soft cel-shaded petals
